:::{#thm-epe-decomposition}
#### Bias, variance and noise

Let:

- $\paren{\newpredvar, \newoutvar}$ be a [new observation](#def-new-observation) relative to the random [training set](#def-training-set) $\trainset$,
- $\noise$ be the [noise](#def-noise) of $\newoutvar$, and
- $\varpar \eqdef \Var{\noise}$ be its [population variance](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-variance), and
- $\biassymf{\predval}$ and $\varsymf{\predval}$ be short forms of the [bias](#def-prediction-bias) $\bias{\predval}$ and the [variance](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-variance) $\Var{\predval}$ of the [prediction](prediction.qmd#def-prediction).

Assume:

- the new [covariate](#def-covariate) value $\newpredvar$ equals the covariate value $\predvar$ of the [prediction](prediction.qmd#def-prediction),
- the population variance $\varpar$ is finite, and
- the expected squared prediction $\E{\sqf{\predval}}$ is finite.

Then the [expected prediction error at $\predvar$](#def-epe)
is the squared [bias](#def-prediction-bias)
of the prediction $\predval$,
plus its [variance](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-variance),
plus $\varpar$:

$$
\epe{\fitproc}{\nobs}{\predvar} = \sqf{\biassymf{\predval}}
+ \varsymf{\predval} + \varpar.
$$ {#eq-epe-decomposition}

:::

::: proof

Every [expectation](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-expectation) below is taken given $\newpredvar = \predvar$.
By @thm-epe-split-noise, the [expected squared prediction error](#def-epe) is the [variance](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-variance) of the [noise](#def-noise) plus the [pMSE](estimation.qmd#def-mse) of the [prediction](prediction.qmd#def-prediction), used as an [estimator](estimation.qmd#def-estimator) of $\truemeanf{\predvar}$.
That pMSE is the squared [bias](#def-prediction-bias) plus the [variance](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-variance).
To see this, add and subtract the [expected prediction](#def-average-fit) $\Epredval$ inside the square and expand it:

$$
\ba
\sqf{\truemeanf{\predvar} - \predval}
&= \sqf{\truemeanf{\predvar} - \Epredval}
+ 2 \paren{\truemeanf{\predvar} - \Epredval} \paren{\Epredval - \predval}
+ \sqf{\Epredval - \predval}.
\ea
$$

This choice splits the error about $\Epredval$, the center of the prediction's distribution, so the pieces are the bias and the variance.
Take the expectation of the three terms, one at a time:

$$
\ba
\E{\sqf{\truemeanf{\predvar} - \Epredval}}
&= \sqf{\truemeanf{\predvar} - \Epredval}
&& \text{(a constant is its own expectation)} \\
&= \sqf{\Epredval - \truemeanf{\predvar}} = \sqf{\biassymf{\predval}}
&& \text{(squaring ignores the sign; the bias is $\Epredval - \truemeanf{\predvar}$)} \\
\E{2 \paren{\truemeanf{\predvar} - \Epredval} \paren{\Epredval - \predval}}
&= 2 \paren{\truemeanf{\predvar} - \Epredval} \paren{\Epredval - \E{\predval}}
&& \text{(constants come out of the expectation)} \\
&= 0
&& \text{($\Epredval$ is the expectation of $\predval$)} \\
\E{\sqf{\Epredval - \predval}}
&= \varsymf{\predval}
&& \text{(definition of the variance)}
\ea
$$

Substituting the split of the pMSE into @eq-epe-split-noise:

$$
\ba
\epe{\fitproc}{\nobs}{\predvar}
&= \varpar + \E{\sqf{\truemeanf{\predvar} - \predval}}
&& \text{(separating the noise)} \\
&= \varpar + \sqf{\biassymf{\predval}} + \varsymf{\predval}
&& \text{(separating the bias)} \\
&= \sqf{\biassymf{\predval}} + \varsymf{\predval} + \varpar
&& \text{(reorder the terms)}
\ea
$$

:::
